fields.description: The legal name of the issuing entity, including any suffix such as Incorporated or Ltd.
The principal amount of the deal as a plain number, without currency symbols or thousands separators.
The settlement currency of the deal.
The date the deal settles, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).
Whether the deal is marked as confidential.
The fee type shown in the fees section of the form, if any fees are mentioned.

groups.description: Each party involved in the deal, one row per party.

fields.description: The legal name of the party, including any suffix such as Incorporated or Ltd.
The party's role in the deal.
The amount associated with this party as a plain number, without currency symbols or thousands separators.
